jobgether-jobgether:lever:28b99f90-cde6-.title: Russian Voice Actor - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobgether-jobgether:lever:28b99f90-cde6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Russian Voice Actor - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in India. This role offers experienced Russian voice professionals the opportunity to contribute directly to the development of next-generation AI voice technologies. You’ll use your performance expertise to create and evaluate high-quality speech data for advanced language and voice models. The work combines professional voice acting with linguistic evaluation, annotation, and AI-assisted testing. You’ll assess pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional variation across a range of speech samples. Your feedback will help AI systems produce Russian speech that sounds more accurate, natural, expressive, and human. The role is ideal for detail-oriented voice professionals who are curious about emerging technology and passionate about language. Your expertise will contribute to AI experiences with potential applications across education, entertainment, accessibility, and more. Record scripted speech material in Russian for AI training and evaluation purposes. Evaluate AI-generated voice outputs for linguistic accuracy, pronunciation, naturalness, tone, pacing, and overall quality. Provide expert feedback on emotional expression, vocal delivery, and regional or linguistic variation. Identify, annotate, and document errors or inconsistencies in AI-generated speech. Collaborate with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation methodologies, and voice-design guidelines. Apply professional voice-acting judgment to distinguish authentic, expressive Russian speech from outputs requiring improvement. Deliver consistent, high-quality recordings while following project-specific technical and performance guidelines. Contribute observations and recommendations that help improve the quality and reliability of Russian voice models. Requirements Demonstrated professional experience in Russian voice acting, dubbing, narration, or a related performance discipline. Strong command of Russian pronunciation, intonation, pacing, and natural spoken expression. Ability to deliver clear, authentic, nuanced, and consistent vocal performances from scripted material. Excellent attention to detail when assessing pronunciation, tone, emotional expression, and linguistic accuracy. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide precise and actionable feedback. Experience in voice training, coaching, linguistic annotation, language evaluation, or similar activities is a plus. Familiarity with AI tools, speech technologies, or language-model evaluation is advantageous. Ability to work independently and reliably in a remote freelance environment. Access to a high-quality recording setup, including a reliable microphone and quiet recording environment. Secure computer and stable internet connection suitable for recording and evaluation work. Benefits Freelance contract with a flexible remote working arrangement. Pay range of $6 to $65 per hour , with the final rate determined by experience, expertise, and geographic location. Opportunity to apply professional Russian voice expertise to cutting-edge AI development. Exposure to emerging AI voice and speech technologies. Opportunity to directly influence the quality and naturalness of future AI voice experiences. Potential impact across global applications including education, entertainment, accessibility, and other use cases. Company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and paid time off are not provided for contractors. Contractors provide their own secure computer, high-quality microphone, recording setup, and stable internet connection.
